children: PC Jeweller shares surged more than 11 percent on September 4, extending the previous session's gains after the company said it had repaid debt owed to another lender and remained on track to become debt-free this month. The stock jumped 11.3 percent to Rs 11.71 in afternoon trade, its highest level in around nine months, taking the company's market capitalisation to about Rs 11,250 crore. PC Jeweller shares had gained 3.3 percent in the previous session as well.

The rally came after PC Jeweller said on Thursday that it had cleared its outstanding debt to one more bank under its September 2024 settlement agreement with a consortium of lenders. With the latest repayment, the jewellery retailer has now cleared all outstanding debt owed to nine of the 14 consortium banks. The company said all these repayments were completed ahead of their scheduled due dates.

PC Jeweller has also discharged more than 96 percent of the outstanding debt owed to the remaining five banks. It expects to repay the balance -- less than 4 percent of the outstanding amount -- and achieve debt-free status during September.

The repayments are part of a one-time settlement agreement signed on September 30, 2024, between PC Jeweller and a 14-bank consortium led by State Bank of India. The agreement was aimed at resolving the company's stressed loan book, which stood at nearly Rs 4,100 crore as of March 2024.

The consortium also includes Union Bank of India, Punjab National Bank, Axis Bank, IndusInd Bank, Bank of India, IDBI Bank, Karur Vysya Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, Indian Overseas Bank, Canara Bank, Indian Bank, Bank of Baroda and IDFC First Bank.

The sharp rise in PC Jeweller shares also came in a positive broader market, although the stock substantially outperformed the benchmark indices. At 2:08 pm, the Sensex was up 533 points, or 0.70 percent, at 76,685.98, while the Nifty 50 gained 70 points, or 0.29 percent, to 23,943.35.
PC Jeweller has gained about 25 percent so far in 2026, compared with an 8.4 percent decline in the Nifty 50 over the same period.

title: PC Jeweller stock surges 11% to nine-month high; debt-free target this month fuels rally
